subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode

question: Should this broad interactive-parity branch land as one core PR with default-on update_plan and expanded agent-harness SDK helpers, or should it be split/narrowed before merge?
rationale: The PR changes core interaction policy, default tool exposure, plugin SDK surface, and channel/UI behavior; automation can identify blockers but cannot choose the permanent rollout and public API contract.

options.title: Fix and split before merge
options.body: Repair the approval and SDK-boundary defects, then split question infrastructure, plan mode, and goal mode into staged PRs with focused proof.

options.title: Land as one feature after fixes
options.body: Maintainers accept the broad rollout and default-on planning behavior after the blockers and live proof are resolved.

options.title: Defer core rollout
options.body: Pause or close this PR and move optional pieces to plugins or follow-up design work until core ownership is settled.

recommendation.title: Fix and split before merge
recommendation.body: Repair the approval and SDK-boundary defects, then split question infrastructure, plan mode, and goal mode into staged PRs with focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on public plugin SDK and agent harness/runtime boundaries where vincentkoc has the strongest recent history signal.
